threshold_positive: ALT or AST >3x ULN, or histopath grade >=2 (degeneration/necrosis)
curation_notes: Hy Law: ALT>3x + bili>2x = serious. Map Dieckmann caspase >300% to hepatocellular_injury=1. FDA ASO paper: use 100x Cmax hepatocyte ATP/albumin results
LNP/GalNAc class effect; reversible. Distinguish from lipidosis. Note species (rat>>cyno for LNP vacuolation)

primary_assay: CBC platelet count, PF4-PS ELISA, platelet-bound C3d/C4d
threshold_positive: Platelet nadir <75% of baseline, OR PF4-PS OD >0.8, OR clinical grade >=2
curation_notes: PS-ASO class. Inotersen BLACK BOX: use PLT nadir <=75% as positive. PF4-PS OD cutoff from literature. Map per-oligo outcome from Janas/inotersen

threshold_positive: C3a >2x baseline, OR SC5b-9 >2x, OR CH50/AH50 drop >30%
threshold_negative: C3a/C5a/SC5b-9 within 1.5x baseline; no CH50 change
curation_notes: CARPA: IV LNP main risk. Patisiran NDA: mandatory premedication defined CARPA threshold. Cyno > rat for complement
source_examples: Patisiran NDA; Janas 2018; PS complement reviews

primary_assay: TLR7/8/9 reporter assay, IFN-a ELISA, ISG15/MX1 RNA
threshold_positive: IFN-a >50 pg/mL, OR ISG15/MX1 >3x, OR TLR7/8 reporter >2x baseline
curation_notes: CpG/poly-U motifs drive TLR9/TLR7. PS amplifies TLR9 1.8x. Distinguish from cytokine release. Map papargyri innate immune readouts

threshold_positive: IL-6 >50 pg/mL OR TNF-a >25 pg/mL, OR Trp:Kyn <20 (low ratio = IDO active)
threshold_negative: IL-6 <10 pg/mL; Trp:Kyn normal (>45 in rodents)
curation_notes: IDO1 activation by oligo+PS linkage drives kynurenine. ASTCT CRS grade >=1 = positive. Janas cytokine data is primary source

threshold_positive: KIM-1 >2x baseline, OR histopath grade >=2 tubular degeneration
curation_notes: DO NOT use rat renal as primary human predictor (ICH S7A). PS-ASO class accumulates in proximal tubule lysosomes. Flag rat overestimation in metadata

threshold_positive: LAMP1 lysosomal staining grade >=2, or tissue TK detection
curation_notes: Document as separate from tubular injury. Common at high dose; not always adverse. Note reversibility

primary_assay: RNA-seq off-target knockdown, caspase-3 activation, seed-match score
threshold_positive: Caspase >300% (Papargyri/Dieckmann threshold), OR >5 off-target genes knocked down >70%, OR seed-match score >0.6
curation_notes: This is THE Papargyri/Dieckmann key label. Caspase >300% used in 768-gapmer dataset. Seed score >0.6 is computational proxy for this endpoint

threshold_positive: APTT >1.5x ULN, OR fibrinogen <70% baseline, OR ATII <70% baseline
threshold_negative: APTT within normal range; fibrinogen normal
curation_notes: PS-ASO direct binding to coagulation factors. Nusinersen APTT monitoring defines threshold. Map from NDA labels

primary_assay: NfL/GFAP CSF+serum ELISA, TDP-43 IHC, neurological exam
threshold_positive: NfL >2x baseline (serum), OR GFAP >2x, OR TDP-43 inclusion IHC grade >=2
curation_notes: IT oligos: NfL is most sensitive CNS injury marker (nusinersen NDA precedent). Delayed CNS tox (months post-dose). NEAT1 hub programs = D1 risk

threshold_positive: ISR grade >=2 (moderate erythema/swelling), OR histopath inflammatory infiltrate grade >=2
curation_notes: GalNAc/naked SC. Inclisiran ISR ~8% clinical rate defines severity threshold. Note PS fraction correlation

primary_assay: CD68/F4/80 IHC, hepatic macrophage infiltration, liver cytokines
threshold_positive: CD68/F4/80 IHC grade >=2, OR hepatic IL-6 >3x baseline
curation_notes: ASO class effect in liver; usually mild and reversible. Correlated with hepatocellular findings but distinct. Note species
